sections.dataText: Indicators are calculated for selected rural areas and linked to NUTS 2 and NUTS 3 regions. Use the dashboard and analysis pages to explore values, compare locations and read detailed explanations for each indicator.
sections.mapText: The map on the right shows borders of NUTS 2 and NUTS 3 regions, and highlihts NUTS regions used in the project. You can switch between levels to see how local pilot areas relate to the wider statistical regions.

map.alt: Map of {{level}} regions used in the project
map.caption: Source: official NUTS classification (Eurostat).

homepage.title: SMART ERA
homepage.description: This EU project is leveraging the digital age and smart strategies to breathe new life into these regions, turning challenges into opportunities. From revitalizing infrastructure to fostering entrepreneurship, we’re creating practical solutions that make a real difference. With every step, we’re building a future where rural areas are attracting talent and investment, and setting the stage for sustainable growth.

1_1_1.name: Digital Connectivity
1_1_1.description: Measures the availability and quality of digital network connections within a rural community.

1_1_2.name: Traditional Connectivity
1_1_2.description: Assesses traditional, non-digital means of connectivity (e.g., postal services, telephony), etc.

1_1_4.name: Affordability of Internet
1_1_4.description: Examines the affordability and economic accessibility of internet services for rural residents, etc.

2_1_1.name: Public Transport Accessibility
2_1_1.description: Measures the extent to which public transport services are available and accessible, etc.

2_2_2.name: Low-Carbon Vehicles
2_2_2.description: Assesses adoption and use of vehicles powered by low-carbon or renewable fuels, etc.

3_2_1.name: Local Energy Generation
3_2_1.description: Measures the spread of localized energy generation facilities, enhancing local energy resilience.
